method: Evidence-based daily-driver decision matrix; no master score or numeric rank
recommendation_confidence: provisional, benchmark-backed recommendation for this rig; not long-term stability certification
coverage_policy: Use every tested family; never mix Gyro-S rc1 sampled suites into rc2 evidence, impute missing data, double-count shared per-file samples as effort repetitions, or equate tool warnings with safety certification. TPS stays in separate diagnostics.
deployment_policy: A capability result alone cannot override observed memory, campaign-validity, safety-gate and matched-coverage caveats. Existing stock evidence is preferred over experimental fork-only wins for the default recommendation. This report does not change the deployed model.
